notes.title: Important NEWS!!!
notes.content:
Dear my friends,

After I see the many negative reviews and people doesn't read the description, I've decided I will release Chapter 2 and next Chapters only on my Patreon site ([url=patreon.com/sinsmith]patreon.com/sinsmith[/url]). 
The main reason of my decision, I can create/work, if I don't read these negative comments. I don't want that if these people would affect my job. I always appreciate the helpful suggestions/wishes etc....but not hate behavior.

[b]Chapter 2 will releases in February with:[/b]
- 2 new species
- 6 new sexual poses
- New maps

Follow me on [url=patreon.com/sinsmith]Patreon[/url]!

Thank you for your understanding!

Bests,
Steve
